“Madagascar is not a destination — it is a feeling you carry home.”

With over 16 years on the ground, The Madagascar Collection is an owner-run travel company specialising in tailor-made holidays across North West Madagascar — from pristine island escapes and marine safaris to cultural encounters and historic sailing voyages aboard our 115-year-old schooner, Luna Moon.

Where We Take You

Our Destinations

View all locations

Nosy Be

The perfume island and our home base — a lush volcanic island ringed by turquoise water, ylang-ylang plantations and some of the richest marine life in the Indian Ocean. Read more

Nosy Komba

The sacred lemur island. A short boat ride from Nosy Be, Nosy Komba is home to semi-wild black lemurs that roam freely through protected forest, alongside a lively beachfront village market. Read more

Nosy Sakatia

A small serene island west of Nosy Be, known for its sea turtle sanctuary, pristine coral gardens and unhurried pace. One of the best spots in the archipelago for snorkelling from shore. Read more

Ankazoberavina

A secluded private island in the Nosy Be archipelago offering complete seclusion without sacrificing comfort. One of TMC’s signature stays — no day visitors, no crowds. Read more

Nosy Iranja

Two small islands joined at low tide by a breathtaking white sandbar stretching into impossibly turquoise water. One of Madagascar’s most photographed and most magical natural features. Read more

Nosy Ankao

Madagascar’s most exclusive private island destination — remote, pristine and accessible only by light aircraft or helicopter. Ultra-luxury in true wilderness. Read more

Diego Suarez

Madagascar’s dramatic far north gateway, where red rock formations, emerald bays and pristine national parks converge. Still largely undiscovered by international travellers. Read more

Morondava

Home to Madagascar’s most iconic landscape — the Avenue of the Baobabs. A journey into one of the world’s last great wild places, rich in endemic wildlife and extraordinary scenery. Read more
